दक्षिणरेलव/ेSOUTHERN RAILWAY 

   चने्नमैडंल/CHENNAI DIVISION 

No. PUB/MAS/2024/10/18                                                      Date: 28.10.2024 
 

प्रसेक्षवज्ञक्षि /PRESS RELEASE 

CHANGES IN PATTERN OF TRAIN SERVICES 

According priority to passenger safety and Safety of train operations, as a part of 
ongoing Engineering works, Line Block/Signal Block is permitted in Chennai Central 
and Arakkonam section at Avadi Yard from 00:00 hrs to 03:30 hrs on 29th October 
2024 (03 Hours 30 Minutes). Consequently, the following are the changes in the 
pattern of EMU train services. 

A. FULL CANCELLATION OF EMU TRAIN SERVICES: 

 
1. Train No. 43894, Pattabiram Military Siding – Avadi EMU local leaving 

Pattabiram Military Siding at 23:50 hrs is FULLY CANCELLED on 28th 
October 2024. 
 

2. Train No. 66007, Moore Market Complex – Avadi EMU local leaving Moore 
Market Complex at 23:40 hrs is FULLY CANCELLED on 28th October 2024. 

 

3. Train No. 43001, Moore Market Complex – Avadi EMU local leaving Moore 
Market Complex at 00:15 hrs is FULLY CANCELLED on 29th October 2024. 

B.  PARTIAL CANCELLATION OF EMU TRAIN SERVICES: 

1. Train No. 43125, Moore Market Complex - Pattabiram Military Siding EMU local 
leaving Moore Market Complex at 22:40 hrs is PARTIALLY CANCELLED 
between Avadi and Pattabiram Military Siding on 28th October 2024. 
 

2. Train No. 43128, Pattabiram Military Siding - Moore Market Complex EMU local 
leaving Pattabiram Military Siding at 22:45 hrs is PARTIALLY CANCELLED 
between Avadi and Moore Market Complex on 28th October 2024. 
 

3. Train No. 43102, Pattabiram Military Siding - Moore Market Complex EMU local 
leaving Pattabiram Military Siding at 03:30hrs is PARTIALLY CANCELLED 
between Pattabiram Military Siding and Avadi on 29th October 2024. 

C. DIVERSION OF EMU TRAIN SERVICE: 

1. Train No. 06744, Sullurupeta - Moore Market Complex EMU local leaving 

Sullurupeta at 21:00 hrs is DIVERTED to Avadi via Korukkupet and 
Vyasarpadi Jiva on 28th October 2024.         

       

 
SD/-
